fields.System.Title: RET-102 — Validate return quantity against what shipped
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want the system to stop me authorising more than we sent,
so that we do not credit or restock stock we never shipped.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an order line that shipped 8 of 10 ordered, then an RMA for more than 8 is
  • rejected.
  • - Given an existing RMA for part of a line, then a further RMA cannot exceed the
  • remaining shipped quantity.
  • - Given an already-returned quantity, then it is deducted from what is still returnable.
  • - Given a product not on the original order, then it cannot be added to that RMA.
  • - Given the validation, then it reads shipped quantities through an outbound service
  • call.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, outbound |
| Tables | rma, order_line |
| Risks | Returning more than was shipped creates stock from nothing ([doc 05 WF 9](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
